LanguageData.PhobosHold_GizmoDesc: Choose a place on the world map. The aircraft flies there and circles over it for as long as its fuel allows, then turns for home with enough to get back. With a repeater kit and a radio it passes calls on from its height while it circles, and on the way.
LanguageData.PhobosHold_GizmoEndDesc: Stop circling and fly home now, or come down where it is if the fuel will not reach.
LanguageData.PhobosHold_NoTile: Choose a place on the world map.
LanguageData.PhobosHold_NoFuel: The {VEHICLE} has not the fuel to fly there, hold a while and come home.
LanguageData.PhobosHold_MsgOrdered: The {VEHICLE} is on its way to hold station.
LanguageData.PhobosHold_MsgHolding: The {VEHICLE} is holding station, circling over the place you chose.
LanguageData.PhobosHold_MsgFuel: The {VEHICLE} is turning for home: it has the fuel for the way back and little more.
LanguageData.PhobosHold_MsgEnded: The {VEHICLE} ends its hold and turns for home.
